domain_source_comparison.overlap_note: HC3 contains QA domains (reddit_eli5, wiki_qa, medicine, finance, openkbase); RAID subset contains abstracts domain.

leakage_risk_assessment.recommendation: Maintain complete separation of datasets. Use HC3 for primary model fine-tuning and in-domain validation, and hold out RAID strictly as an independent, out-of-distribution adversarial robustness test set.
